I went back to the bank for help. There were two ladies and one gentleman sitting there, but instead of helping me, they spoke very rudely and simply said “Come tomorrow, we are busy.” This is extremely unprofessional, especially the way they spoke to a female customer.
Later, my mother went to the bank, and only then one of the ladies told us to call the toll-free number, block the previous debit card, and then the new card would get activated.

The staff member Supriya, who handled my loan, is not answering my calls at all ..
